note: Preserve all supported marker-role interpretations; expected roles describe completeness and cannot establish a preference. Exact duplicate solutions may be deduplicated. Single-fill rivals become separate readings.

records.expected_role_note: Expected roles annotate missing roles only; they do not decide between interpretations.

removed_policies.prefer_more_mapped_roles: Removed: under the current option construction every combination maps the same number of elements, so the rule could never fire. A declared protection that cannot fire is worse than none.
removed_policies.drop_duplicate_role_solutions_when_alter: Removed: dropping a duplicate-role solution decided a semantic question syntactically, and when no alternative existed it asserted two fillers of one role in one reading. Replaced by expand_single_fill_duplicates_into_rival_readings, which keeps every filler as a rival reading and drops nothing.

records.literal_note: A preceding marker may be literal when the next marker offers a subject class or a later marker may bind the same role. Other marker-versus-literal boundaries are not yet exhaustively analyzed.

records.note: Boundary-attached unmarked adjunct is an alternative to a literal value span.
A boundary-attached composed time is a rival of the literal value; it does not determine attachment.
